request_body.text: Juniper export acceptance policy, version 2.4. For the stable profile, p95 export latency must be at most 220 ms and omitted-record rate must be at most 0.50%. For the preview profile, p95 export latency must be at most 160 ms and omitted-record rate must be at most 0.10%. Both limits must be met; equality passes. The two profiles have separate acceptance limits. Version 2.4 supersedes version 2.3 only for version 2.4 runs.
